<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OnlineShopOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-order">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShopOrder" name="Online Shop Purchase" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StartOrder" name="Order started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToLogin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToLogin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LoginToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Split_Selection" name="Split selection and payment setup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LoginToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToSelectItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToSetPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items to purchase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToSelectItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectItemsToJoinSelection</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectItemsToChooseReward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToSetPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetPaymentToJoinSelection</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Join_Selection" name="Join item and payment setup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectItemsToJoinSelection</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetPaymentToJoinSelection</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinSelectionToSplitPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Split_Payment" name="Payment option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinSelectionToSplitPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitPaymentToPay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitPaymentToInstallment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitPaymentToPay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PayToMergePayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteInstallment" name="Complete installment agreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitPaymentToInstallment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InstallmentToMergePayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Payment" name="Payment completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PayToMergePayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InstallmentToMergePayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergePaymentToJoinDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose free reward option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectItemsToChooseReward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseRewardToJoinDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Join_Delivery" name="Payment and reward completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergePaymentToJoinDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseRewardToJoinDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinDeliveryToMergeDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Delivery" name="Delivery required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinDeliveryToMergeDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToMergeDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeDeliveryToDeliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeDeliveryToDeliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliverToSplitReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Split_Return" name="Items returned for exchange?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliverToSplitReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitReturnToReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitReturnToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitReturnToReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToMergeDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitReturnToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToLogin" sourceRef="StartEvent_StartOrder" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginToSplit" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_Split_Selection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSelectItems" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Selection" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSetPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Selection" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectItemsToJoinSelection" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Gateway_Join_Selection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectItemsToChooseReward" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPaymentToJoinSelection" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_Join_Selection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinSelectionToSplitPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_Join_Selection" targetRef="Gateway_Split_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitPaymentToPay" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Payment" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitPaymentToInstallment" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Payment" targetRef="Task_CompleteInstallment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PayToMergePayment" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InstallmentToMergePayment" sourceRef="Task_CompleteInstallment" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergePaymentToJoinDelivery" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Payment" targetRef="Gateway_Join_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseRewardToJoinDelivery" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_Join_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinDeliveryToMergeDelivery" sourceRef="Gateway_Join_Delivery" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeDeliveryToDeliver" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Delivery" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliverToSplitReturn" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Gateway_Split_Return"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitReturnToReturn" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Return" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitReturnToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Return" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToMergeDelivery" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Delivery"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
